content.text: Skip to content Liquified Natural Gas - LNG What is Natural Gas Application of LNG Benefits of LNG LNG Value Chain What is Liquefied Natural Gas Liquefied natural gas, or LNG, is natural gas in its liquid form. When natural gas is cooled to -162 °C, it becomes a clear, odourless, non-corrosive, non-toxic, non-flammable liquid and dissipates in case of leaks. LNG occupies 1/600th of the volume of natural gas making it convenient and cost-effective for storage and transportation. Methane rich (95%) gas, with N2, CO2 Extracted from gas wells in gaseous state Liquefied Cryogenically to -162 °C Stored and transported in a specialised container vessel at atmospheric pressure Application of LNG Natural gas can be used in a variety of ways Power Generation Power Generation Natural gas used for generating electricity for power plants and on-site generation. Industrial Industrial Natural gas uses include heating, generating electricity, manufacturing products like fertilizers, paints and medicines Transport Transport LNG is used directly as a transportation fuel for trucks, buses, taxis, rail, and ships. Mining Mining Used as fuel for yellow plant that are used to move and process mineral within a mine. Benefits of LNG We're transforming the way people think about natural gas and building a new energy future for Africa. Economical Up to 25% cheaper than traditional fuels like petrol and diesel Sustainable Lowering emissions, reducing carbon footprint Safer Non-toxic and non-corrosive Stable Supply DNG has developed a network to enable a reliable LNG supply.
